nodes.label: The Method 1.6 — Volume 2 (reader-facing volume)
nodes.rationale: One claim, one object, and every place the demonstration failed: the volume is organised so Part III is self-contained for the general result, Part V for the physics, and Chapter 28 plus Appendix B for checking the work.

nodes.label: Matthew Lach (independent researcher, author)
Note from the collaborator who did the computing
nodes.rationale: The register is evidence not that the work was error-prone but that errors were converted into structure; seven recurring mechanisms account for twenty-nine entries, and each became a protocol in Part I.

nodes.label: The Lach Cylinder
nodes.rationale: Named 'over ν' rather than 'graded by ν' because ν grades every chain of Λ but grades Λ itself nowhere — 24 of 70 comparable pairs have ν decreasing.

nodes.label: Λ — the closed index of atomic transitions
nodes.rationale: Deliberately a recoding that adds no physics beyond the quantum numbers, so whatever it exhibits is a property of indexing rather than of atoms.

nodes.label: Closed index (fixed point of ℛ)
nodes.rationale: Being a fixed point gives exactly six things — alphabet, bounds, totality of the membership test, admissible cells, adjoinable axes, imposable constraints — and never that the coordinates refer to anything.

nodes.label: ℛ — the closure operator over coordinate projections
E(X) — the closure defect
nodes.rationale: Openness is a measurement, not a defect: where a certificate exhibits an operation reaching a fixed point E measures the drawing, where none exists E measures the world.

nodes.label: The eight-coordinate transition cell (n, ℓ, k, q, e, f, g, 2S)
Pauli exclusion as a constraint origin
Hydrogenic radial solution as a constraint origin
Vector coupling as an envelope (2S ≤ k)
nodes.rationale: Three origins yield exact constraints; vector coupling yields an envelope that admits multiplicities no k electrons can carry, at 48.5% density — which is why the tower's dichotomy separates counting from coupling coordinates.

nodes.label: The constraint graph is a tree (treewidth 1)
Caps — every count stated at explicit caps
nodes.rationale: Λ is infinite, so counts are cap-dependent and the shape is not; a structural claim is checked at no fewer than four cap settings.

nodes.label: F — the single closed generating expression
The void — the shadow of the exclusion principle
The occupancy measure
μ_Λ — the Möbius function in closed form
Distributivity and rank conservation of Λ
Sperner, and not symmetric
The seventeen generators
The cylinder as a fibration with two-body fibres
The tower — Λ₈ through Λ₁₃
Λ₉ — the transit level and the last tree level
The clock in the constraint — Λ₉'s composition has a direction
An index has a time column exactly when its cells are moves
The three excluded forms — sum, difference, symmetric function
The periodic table is not a closed index (E = 36)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the opening case because it is the most successful index in the physical sciences and its openness is exactly thirty-six admitted-but-absent cells: you have to be told period 1 holds two elements.

nodes.label: Self-reference — alphabet, order, bounds (S1, S2, S3)
Self-defence — six disjoint defences
nodes.rationale: Six rather than three because closure never gives reference: a wrong value is caught only from outside the index and a wrong derivation only along a second route, and one defence cannot be run by this book at all.

nodes.label: ⅅ_phys — a wrong value in the data
ⅅ_def — a wrong derivation
nodes.rationale: The split exists because a relation that cannot be violated by data is not empty — it is defending the derivation; the reframing came from a refused conclusion that w = V·e 'detects nothing'.

nodes.label: D3 — totality catches a missing value
Extension — E1 cells, E2 axes, E3 constraints
The law of realised closure
nodes.rationale: Restated in certificate form because the first form ('realised in the object's own structure') had no falsifier and could be refuted only by failing to name — ten confirmations with no stated failure mode is what §4.6 forbids.

nodes.label: The realiser certificate
E(X) is the prediction budget
nodes.rationale: An index may be complete or predictive and not both, because a prediction is a proposal about an unlisted cell and completeness is the property of having none. Not a limitation discovered late — it is what completeness means.

nodes.label: The pole at p = 1 — the one hard singularity
nodes.rationale: Corrected by §31.1.1: the pole is where a bracket becomes unnecessary rather than worthless, since a vanishing second difference makes linear interpolation exact.

nodes.label: The bracket — a deduction from measured neighbours
nodes.rationale: Fits nothing and assumes no functional form, returning an interval rather than a value: a fit says where a level probably is, the bracket says where it cannot fail to be.

nodes.label: Rydberg channel (fixed parent, fixed ℓ, varying n)
V = 4ν/3 — the cost of a guarantee
The cost quantity is the Newton decrement
The term function is self-concordant
The floor is algebraic before it is physical (V > 2)
The collection — the bracket-tested species
nodes.rationale: Four numbers for one collection is a disclosure rather than a reconciliation: the totals line (1,105), the table (869), the tested count (930) and the withdrawn 1,442 are printed side by side because reconciling needs twenty rows that are owed.

nodes.label: The TRIVIAL bracket passes 789 of 789 — a signature, not a proof
The failure condition and the bound in the silence
nodes.rationale: A method that has never failed has not been tested; the collection never enters the failure regime, so the silence itself is what is measured.

nodes.label: Collective sections and the assembly rule
Aitken's Δ² has an exact bias on a Rydberg series
Slack — three names, one quantity, a description length
nodes.rationale: The three measures are one quantity because the three objects are one shape, which is why every structural result in the book is a statement about slack.

nodes.label: The Register — the record of withdrawn claims
nodes.rationale: Register entry bodies are never edited; what a past entry recorded is part of the record, so a repair is an appended entry citing the superseded one.

nodes.label: Withdrawals — Chapter 28
Precedent, and what a search can bound
nodes.rationale: Novelty is not the author's to claim; what can be claimed is a bounded search, because the documentary language carries no closure mechanism and so can never settle the question.

nodes.label: The documentary language — the row with no algorithm
A language is a coordinate system (P20)
nodes.rationale: The language a question is posed in bounds whether it can close and at what cost — the notation is the coordinate that makes a rule expressible, not a convenience.

nodes.label: Translation, and E as its price
The cypher analysis
nodes.rationale: It was not designed but noticed and then made explicit; a language that falls silent is the finding, and the identity of the silent language names the kind of object.

nodes.label: Retrieval as a lattice problem
ρ — a property of (document, route)
Order recovery above the tree
The reorderability law
Arity ≤ 3 bijunctive, arity ≥ 4 contains 1-in-3-SAT
Celestial mechanics — families, not trajectories
The nucleon index — a second index of the same construction
String theory — the pole and the generating function
The Calabi–Yau catalogue
The law applied to this book
The Löwdin challenge
nodes.rationale: The target is the observed opening ORDER, not n+ℓ: Madelung inverts 5d/4f and 6d/5f, so deriving n+ℓ exactly would mean deriving something false at two elements.

nodes.label: Madelung's n+ℓ rule — 89% accurate
ν(n,ℓ,q) = n − a·√(n − ℓ − 1 + q/2(2ℓ+1)) — the occupation law
nodes.rationale: Occupancy enters only through Pauli: the fraction q/2(2ℓ+1) in the radicand cuts within-subshell scatter at every tested subshell, while raw occupancy makes every one worse, so the law needs no new coordinate.

nodes.label: The Löwdin solution — the chained self-consistent walk
nodes.rationale: The carried state Chapter 34 argued necessary is carried by the equation itself: at each Z the field of the Z−1 ion is what the arriving electron meets, and the deepest frontier channel is the entrant.

nodes.label: Three bodies, and what a complete index is allowed to say
nodes.rationale: The three negatives are the solution: 'completely solvable as a stratification' and 'no trajectory formula exists' are one statement, and the book had computed that precision before the problem was posed to it.

nodes.label: Mass-uniformity — the law Chapter 36 adds
Montgomery's shape map as the realiser certificate
The principles P1–P23
The protocols — twenty-four procedural rules
The twenty-two prime audits
nodes.rationale: Ordered by what a failure costs; ten test the index and twelve test the book, and the requirement is executable so the audits run on every output.

nodes.label: The grid — the book's method, stated
Triangulation — three results locate a fourth
Commit before you look (§2.13)
Compute, then write — state the number before the interpretation (§2.14)
nodes.rationale: Exists because writing conclusions before reading output was measured rather than deplored: it happens as readily on six cells as on 1,442, so it is not a failure of attention and no amount of care fixes it.

nodes.label: The prime directive — nothing runs unbounded (§2.20)
What is computable, and what is decided (§2.18)
Appendix D — the mathematics, indexed
nodes.rationale: The first attempt failed because ℛ recovers monotone bounds and so applies to ordered coordinates only; the repair is the shape Λ already has — fibre over the categorical axes and put the ordered coordinates inside.

nodes.label: Appendix E — Q, the book's own ignorance indexed
nodes.rationale: An index states its current contents once and its history as history: three live item counts had accumulated because each recomputation was written beside its predecessor rather than replacing it.

nodes.label: Appendix F — the numbers, indexed
nodes.rationale: The domain was changed: an account of a volume's own printed figures belongs to the making of the volume and not to what the volume is about, so what is indexed is quantity-kinds over ordered grounds.
